goal: Evaluate whether specification-derived checks distinguish the historical Node runtime fix from its base revision and expose any unmet runtime requirements.

included: Read-only verification of commits 0ffa3a5 and f8afa3f
Specification-derived runtime selection, package engine, and setup guidance checks
Durable pilot evidence and bounded conclusions

constraints.statement: Run the same committed verifier without modification against both historical revisions.
Derive the checks from the durable feedback record rather than from the historical patch diff.
Do not modify historical files or install dependencies inside either extracted revision.

assumptions.statement: The merged feedback record is the approved requirement source for this bounded pilot.
Commits 0ffa3a5 and f8afa3f are the approved pre-fix and post-fix revisions.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The same verifier runs unchanged against both historical revisions.
evidenceRequired: Verifier fingerprint and command are identical for both runs

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The pilot reports which runtime requirements fail before and pass after the patch.
The pilot explicitly reports requirements that remain unsatisfied after the patch.
Historical revisions remain unchanged and no dependency installation occurs within them.

allowedActions: Add pilot-only verifier, contract, report, and planning evidence on the feature branch
Extract historical revisions into temporary directories for read-only verification
prohibitedActions: Merge, deploy, or change runtime policy
Edit concurrent unit-test or telemetry work

humanGates.decision: Approve the Node runtime mismatch as the historical pilot candidate after its feedback record is merged.
humanGates.when: Before extracting revisions or running the differential pilot.

humanGates.decision: Approve merge and any runtime-policy remediation arising from the pilot.
humanGates.when: After pilot evidence and independent review are complete.
